title: SEBI Board 214th Meeting: Reintroduces Open-Market Buybacks & Intraday MF Borrowing
summary: Open-market buybacks re-allowed from Aug 1, 2026; MFs allowed intraday borrowing up to 20% net assets.

blocks.content: Open-market buybacks re-allowed from Aug 1, 2026; MFs allowed intraday borrowing up to 20% net assets.

items: Open-Market Buybacks: Reintroduced from Aug 1, 2026; completed within 66 working days with min 40% funds deployed in 1st half.
MF Intraday Borrowing: MFs permitted intraday borrowing to manage temporary liquidity mismatches (in addition to 20% net asset borrowing limit).
QTP Claims: Introduced Quick Transmission Processing (QTP) for small-value deceased investor claims.
